events.title: Stability control required on all new light vehicles
events.summary: ESC became mandatory for all newly registered new light passenger and goods vehicles.

events.title: Toyota New Zealand moves to an agency model
events.summary: The Drive Happy Project replaced dealer-owned stock and price negotiation with fixed national pricing and three distributor-held vehicle pools. Dealers became agents earning a fee. MEASUREMENT WARNING: this changes who is recorded as the registering party and how demonstrator stock enters the register.

events.title: Clean Car Discount rebates begin
events.summary: A rebate was paid on application to the first registered person of an eligible low-emission vehicle.

events.title: SsangYong renamed KG Mobility
events.summary: SsangYong New Zealand became KGM at the end of March 2024, a renaming after the company's acquisition by KG Group, not a market entry. The brand registry maps SSANGYONG and KG MOBILITY to KGM, so the make series is continuous.

events.title: Clean Car Standard charges cut by around 80 percent
events.summary: The top rate for new vehicles fell from $67.50 to $15 per gram of CO2 and for used vehicles from $33.75 to $7.50. Existing credits protected from expiring before 31 December 2028. At the time 86 percent of importers faced a net charge.
